title: Vietnamese Sweetcorn Coconut Pudding
summary: A light Vietnamese-style chè made with sweetcorn, coconut milk and a gentle sweetness. It’s creamy, fragrant, and ideal as a vegan snack served warm or chilled.
steps: Put the sweetcorn and half of the coconut milk into a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the corn is tender and the coconut milk is lightly infused.
Add the sugar and a pinch of salt, and stir until dissolved.
Mix the cornstarch with 3 tablespoons of cold coconut milk in a small bowl until smooth.
Lower the heat and stir the cornstarch slurry into the pan slowly. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the pudding thickens and looks glossy.
Pour in the remaining coconut milk and the vanilla extract. Warm through gently for 1 to 2 minutes without boiling.
Taste and adjust the sweetness if needed, then spoon into bowls and serve warm, or chill until set and creamy.
